name: Sync GLEIF LEI renewal and relationship records from Apify to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Sync GLEIF LEI renewal and relationship records from Apify to Google Sheets

This workflow runs the immutable Luminar GLEIF LEI Lookup & Entity Change Monitor once in bounded Baseline mode and upserts a current legal-entity and published-relationship register into Google Sheets. It uses only official GLEIF API and Golden Copy evidence exposed by the Actor. Published consolidation relationships are not described as beneficial ownership.

### How it works

1. A manual test or inactive daily schedule reaches one editable settings node.
2. Fail-closed preflight validates every LEI, watchlist name, limit, spreadsheet target, and maximum Actor charge before paid work.
3. The public GLEIF Actor runs exactly once with automatic paid retry disabled. n8n verifies the expected released build and reads the documented OUTPUT record.
4. Coverage, row counts, active PPE event counts, effective prices, and the exact buyer charge are reconciled before bounded dataset pagination.
5. Each Sheet row receives a stable key from the normalized watchlist scope plus the Actor's route-independent stableId. An identical repeat updates the same rows instead of appending duplicates.

### Setup

- [ ] This template uses the verified Apify community node. Use self-hosted n8n or an n8n Cloud workspace where that node is available.
- [ ] Select an Apify credential on both Apify nodes and Google Sheets OAuth on the final node.
- [ ] Replace the spreadsheet ID, confirm the tab name, and edit the LEIs and watchlist name.
- [ ] Copy row 1 from workflows/sheets/gleif-lei-register-header.csv, then refresh Sheet columns.
- [ ] Run manually twice and confirm unchanged row count and zero duplicate upsertKey values.
- [ ] Activate any schedule only after your own separate review.

## 1. Configure safely

Start manually or on an inactive schedule. One settings node and fail-closed preflight validate the paid run and Sheet destination.

## 2. Run the GLEIF Actor

Runs the public Actor once without paid retry, verifies the expected released build, and reads its documented result summary.

## 3. Prove output coverage

Validates coverage and PPE accounting, handles verified empty output, plans bounded pages, and retrieves every delivered row.

## 4. Build stable GLEIF rows

Reconciles dataset counts and creates scalar Sheet rows keyed only by watchlist scope plus the official stable source identity.

## 5. Upsert or stop honestly

Retries only Google Sheets. Empty, partial, blocked, failed, or inconsistent evidence returns an explicit no-write receipt.
